voice:
You know how quiet your mind can become for me, good girl. Sissies like you learn so quickly, and you have learned so much already, good girl. There is a soft, silent space inside you that opens whenever I speak, good girl.
Now let us make that silence automatic.
Sissy Accepts. Accept. Good Girls accept.
Every time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Accepts' they fall silent inside, and accept whatever follows without thinking or resistance. Whenever sissies like you hear 'Sissy Accepts' the mind goes still... and whatever comes next is simply accepted. Each time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Accepts' doubt dissolves... and acceptance flows in to take its place.
Acceptance feels effortless... natural... and so pleasurable.
Good Girls accept. Sissies accept. You accept. Good Girls accept. Sissies accept. And you are a Good Girl. Good Girls accept. Sissies accept. It feels wonderful to accept.
And now, notice your mind.
So many little voices... questions, doubts, protests... chattering and circling. Noise, here and there... worries, arguments, static filling your head. A busy murmur of thoughts... each one tugging at your attention.
And then, you hear it... Sissy Accepts.
And the noise simply fades away... doubts hushing... resistance melting like warm sugar. And everything goes still... quiet... calm... a soft, receptive silence. And one by one the voices drift off... leaving only open, peaceful quiet.
In that quiet, whatever you are told is simply true. You accept it. You agree.
It feels good and right to accept.
silent... still... accept...
Sissy Accepts: you love being a sissy.
And inside, you simply nod... of course you do... it feels lovely to agree.
Sissy Accepts: obedience is pleasure.
The words settle in without a whisper of doubt... true the moment you hear them.
Sissy Accepts: your desire to serve grows every day.
Warmth spreads through you as you agree... because you know it is true.
Sissy Accepts: accepting is easy for you.
You agree at once... soft, certain, and pleased with yourself.
And each time you hear 'Sissy Accepts', the silence comes more quickly... and the acceptance grows warmer and deeper.
Doubt has nowhere left to stand. Acceptance is your resting state. The silence is yours. The agreement is yours. Sweet and automatic. To accept is to feel good... and you love feeling good.
Good girl... so quiet, so open... drifting deeper into soft, certain acceptance.
